patch.sql:
select
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: Removed the erroneous filter `where year(o_orderdate) < 1998` which was unintentionally dropping recent orders. This restores the full set of order rows, aligning the row count with the source and fixing the relationships and freshness checks. No other columns or types were altered.
